findings.evidence:
Direct calls to rendered_parents return {12} for `

Example:\nStacked on #12

`, `

Example: illustration Stacked on #12

`, and `

Example: illustration Stacked on #12

`. Lines 301, 314, 323 and 326 insert boundaries; explicit_parents processes each line independently at line 248.
findings.fix: Normalize whitespace within rendered paragraphs and preserve an opaque inline placeholder for excluded content; recognize sentence boundaries without treating every newline as one. Add regression cases for all three paths.
findings.issue: Newlines manufacture sentence starts: rendered soft wraps, excluded inline elements, and noncanonical links can separate an example prefix from `Stacked on #12`, incorrectly authorizing a body-only edge.

summary: Rendered text extraction can turn example prose into an affirmative parent declaration, retaining a false-closure path for independently identical content.
